Subject: Post-call recap + joint execution plan (draft attached)

Hi Sophie — thanks for the time earlier today. Fast recap and next steps from our discovery / contract-readiness call. I attached a first-pass "Joint Execution Plan" (JEP) — spreadsheet with milestones, owners, target dates, and dependencies.

Key milestones (high level):
- Legal review + SOW signoff (owner: Sophie / Stellaris legal) — target 2026-09-24
- Security review & evidence handover (owner: Neha / Redwood sec) — target 2026-09-28
- Pre-prod integration & test window (owner: Ethan / Stellaris, with Dylan supporting infra) — window 2026-10-04 — 2026-10-08
- Final go-live readiness checklist (owner: Ben / Redwood + Stella CS) — target 2026-10-14

Dependencies & open items:
- KMS keying / encryption notes (Stellaris to confirm key rotation policy)
- Network egress IPs and firewall allowlist (Stellaris infra)
- SOC2 artifact bundle for access review (we will provide a minimal bundle; Stellaris to confirm whether additional evidence required)

Asks from us: please review the attached JEP and the SOW pages (tab 2). If the high-level dates look good, can you confirm whether the legal review timeline can meet 9/24? If not, propose alternatives and we’ll adjust.

Attachments: Joint-Execution-Plan-v1.xlsx (draft), SOW-Stellaris-2026.pdf (redlined copy)

Thanks — I’ll update the JEP with any edits and circulate for final signoff next week.

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Subject: Re: Post-call recap + joint execution plan (draft attached)

Ben — appreciate the clear recap and the draft JEP. Quick notes after reviewing with our legal and infra teams:

1) Legal: we can aim for 9/24 but need one final pricing appendix updated (we redlined two small items in the SOW). I attached the two-line edit (will send formally via legal counsel if acceptable).
2) Security: KMS rotation policy — we use a quarterly rotation cadence. Can Redwood confirm support for customer-managed keys? Also need to confirm whether audit logs can be retained for 12 months (this is a requirement for some of our risk teams).
3) Pre-prod window: 10/04–10/08 works for the initial integration tests; we’d like a 48-hour blackout buffer before handling PHI-producing prompts in prod.

I’m looping Ethan on infra specifics. If you can update the JEP with the KMS option and retention notes, I think we can move quickly to sign-off.

Thanks,
Sophie
Director of Product Ops | Stellaris Health
sophie.ramos@stellarishealth.com

Hi Sophie / Ethan — thanks for the quick review. I updated the JEP (attached v2) and incorporated:
- KMS: Redwood supports customer-managed keys (we’ll coordinate key material exchange and acceptance testing during the pre-prod window). Added an action for Stellaris infra to provide KMS contact and rotation SLA.
- Retention: default audit log retention is 6 months; we can extend to 12 months for enterprise customers — added as a billable option in the SOW appendix (line item included).

Proposed updated timeline (from the JEP v2):
- Legal & SOW signoff: target 2026-09-27 (moved 3 days for legal headroom)
- Security evidence handover: 2026-09-29
- Pre-prod integration & verification: 2026-10-04 — 2026-10-08 (48-hr blackout before prod confirmed)
- Production go-live: 2026-10-14 (target)

Open items required to lock dates:
- Stellaris to confirm KMS contact and provide allowlist IPs by 2026-09-21
- Legal to accept final SOW appendix by 2026-09-24 (we can extend if needed)

Attachments: Joint-Execution-Plan-v2.xlsx, SOW-Stellaris-2026-redline.pdf

If these dates look OK, I’ll prepare the signature packet and DocuSign envelope for the SOW and signature page. Requesting signoff on timeline by EOD Fri 9/17 so we can hit the legal cadence.

Best,
Ben
